  • 20.07.2026 IT Forging (Thailand) Co., Ltd. Supports Youth Learning and Career Development IT Forging (Thailand) Co., Ltd. organized a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiative under the project "Creating Career Opportunities for Youth in the Community" at Ban Pluakdaeng School, Rayong Province, during 12–20 July 2026. The project involved the construction and handover of a jujube greenhouse to serve as an agricultural learning center and help develop vocational skills for students. The project was made possible through the dedication of the company's employee volunteers, who worked together throughout every stage of the construction process, including site preparation, structural installation, insect-net installation, and cultivation area preparation. Their collective efforts resulted in a fully equipped greenhouse ready for cultivating jujube trees and other agricultural crops. The initiative aims to create a pesticide-free agricultural learning center within the school, giving students hands-on experience in cultivation techniques and farming practices. It also encourages self-reliance and responsible resource management, laying an important foundation for sustainable community development.

  • 14.07.2026 IT Forging (Thailand) Co., Ltd. Enhances Youth Preparedness Through Earthquake and Building Collapse Prevention and Mitigation Training IT Forging (Thailand) Co., Ltd. supported the Youth Disaster Prevention Training Program 2026 under the theme “Earthquake and Building Collapse Prevention and Mitigation”, organized by Tasit Subdistrict Administrative Organization, Rayong Province, on 14 July 2026 at Ban Khlong Kram School and Ban Nong Bon School. The program aimed to enhance students’ and educational personnel’s knowledge, understanding, and practical skills for responding appropriately to emergency situations. During the training, students and school staff participated in both theoretical and practical sessions covering disaster prevention and mitigation measures, safe evacuation procedures, and appropriate responses in the event of a building collapse. The program also featured demonstrations and emergency drills, enabling participants to apply their knowledge in realistic situations, enhance their preparedness, and reduce potential risks from disasters that may occur in everyday life.
